description: This Java class defines a tenant-specific tracing configuration, including sampling modes for tracing spans, with support for device-specific overrides and JSON serialization annotations.

classes.name: TenantTracingConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for tenant-specific tracing settings, including sampling modes and device-specific overrides.

methods.name: getSamplingMode
methods.description: Returns the default sampling mode for the tenant.

methods.name: setSamplingMode
methods.description: Sets the default sampling mode for the tenant.

methods.name: getSamplingModePerAuthId
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable map of device-specific sampling modes.

methods.name: setSamplingModePerAuthId
methods.description: Sets device-specific sampling modes, overriding the default for specified devices.

methods.name: getSamplingMode
methods.description: Returns the sampling mode for a specific device, or the default if not set.
